title: Beanconqueror Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for beanconqueror metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag beanconqueror metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your beanconqueror metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
